weather.subtitle: Configure weather provider, polling cadence, and forecast retention. Tenant settings cascade to every farm unless overridden.

imagery.title: Imagery integration
imagery.subtitle: Configure satellite product and cloud-cover threshold. Tenant settings cascade to every farm and land unit unless overridden.

detection.title: Detection
detection.subtitle: Sub-block grid anomaly sensitivity. Lower z-score = more sensitive. Falls back to the platform default; individual blocks can override on their grid config card.

section.farmHint: Pick a farm to view its resolved chain and override values for that farm only.

cellRollup.title: Block health from cells
cellRollup.help: A cell-level tree gives every grid cell its own status. Choose how those cells make one status for the whole block. A tree that judges the whole block always counts in full.

rule.share: The worst status on a share of the cells decides
rule.most_common: The status on the most cells decides

ruleHelp.worst: One cell at Alert makes the whole block Alert. Cautious, and noisy on large blocks.
ruleHelp.share: A status decides only when it, or a worse one, covers at least the percent you set. One bad cell shows on the map but does not recolour the block.
ruleHelp.most_common: Calm, but a real hotspot can be hidden. A tie goes to the worse status.

cellRollup.shareError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
cellRollup.saved: Saved. The map uses the new rule on its next load.
cellRollup.failed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
